verificationMethod: Playwright headless browser, getBoundingClientRect on the exact selectors flagged in the original report
summary: All 5 overflow regressions from the 10:31Z scan are RESOLVED. Verified at the original viewport sizes (390x844 mobile + 1440x900 desktop).

findings.originalClaim: Desktop /item/4: .similar-card rail overflows right edge by ~223px
findings.currentState: 0 overflowing .similar-card elements (12 cards rendered, all 159px wide, all inside viewport.right at 1440)
findings.fix: CSS — .similar-strip converted from horizontal-scroll flex to wrapping grid with `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr))`. Cards now lay out in rows that wrap inside the right rail's content column instead of extending past it.

findings.originalClaim: Mobile /: .csfloat-home-preview-card rail overflows right edge by ~142px
findings.currentState: 0 overflowing .csfloat-home-preview-card elements (6 cards rendered, all inside viewport at 390)
findings.fix: CSS — .csfloat-home-preview-row had `grid-auto-flow: column + grid-auto-columns: 160px` forcing single-row scroll. Overrode to `grid-auto-flow: row` + `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr))` with `width: auto !important` on children.

findings.originalClaim: Mobile /market: category subnav + ticker overflows right edge
findings.currentState: 0 overflowing .csfloat-subnav-tab elements (8 tabs rendered, wrap to multiple rows). Ticker hidden on mobile.
findings.fix: CSS — .csfloat-subnav-inner forced flex-wrap: wrap on mobile. .ticker-section display:none below 768px (csfloat-parity tickers don't survive 390px without wrapping the marquee).

findings.currentState: 0 overflowing .db-row elements (31 rows rendered, all stacked vertically as cards on mobile)
findings.fix: CSS — root cause was `.db-row { min-width: 780px }` set in design.css line 12903. min-width wins over max-width, which is why all earlier overflow patches failed. Reset to `min-width: 0 !important` on mobile + `display: flex; flex-direction: column` on tr/td so cells stack vertically as cards.

findings.originalClaim: Mobile /item/4: .similar-card rail overflows right edge by ~337px
findings.currentState: 0 overflowing .similar-card elements at 390px (12 cards rendered, wrap to multiple rows)
findings.fix: Same CSS fix as desktop /item/4 — wrapping grid replaces horizontal-scroll rail.
